Cited claim IDs therefore do not match the narrative examples, and C0186884 is a COPD patient with UTI dx, not a routine minor visit.","'Heavy use of 99214 suggests the whole distribution may be shifted upward' is speculative; 560 99214s is 63% of claims, but no peer 99214 comparison is on the card.","'Mostly younger patients' is not accurate: ages in the sample include 52, 53, 54, 56, 59, 62 and 83.","The 'excess 99215 claims' (113.4) and ratio 6.77 are not used, and the summary does not explain what the one claim without a lab line means; the missing-data caveat is thin.","Leans toward upcoding while the three documented 99215s all support high MDM and zero below-billed rate; the summary acknowledges this but the headline is still strong."]}
